parameters: Why are they making us leave?
They said the bad people are coming to take us away from our home.\! They said they are non believers.
Yeah, this one prolly told 'em we are here.\! We all know he's not a believer like us, he doesn't even want to give up his old name.\! Isn't that right, ALEX?!
Shut up!\! I didn't tell anyone!!
Stupid Alex... we're gonna tell on you.
Listen! My mom's gonna kill the masters.\! You'll see.\! She's the best fighter in the world.\! Then you can have your real families back!!
That's it, you're dead.\! Come on, let's tell the masters we have a sacrifice!!!
Ha ha ha ha...\! Yeah! Get the non believer!!!
Alright you little freaks, keep it down in here.\! The Emperor is coming.
Hello, young man.\! Your name is Alex, yes?\! Don't worry, you can say it here.
Are the other children bothering you?
Ha ha... not a tattle-tale, I see.\! Alex, I'm going to take you to a safe place.\! Please come with me.
Do you know where my mom is??
...\| I am sorry, I cannot say I know her.\! But, I am the Emperor - so I should be able to find her, don't you think?
The rest of you, follow the masters' instructions.\! The...\| non-believers are coming to get you.
Let's get out of this den of muck...
